cycle.claim_boundary: The induction is conditional on an already encoded, repaired MPFR-85 state lying in the fixed-leaf Q007s tube. It certifies sampling-time fixed-leaf conservation, tube re-entry, and stage positivity for the sealed 17x17 backend and row-major repair. It does not certify arbitrary exact-state boundary encoding, trajectory accuracy, shadowing time, performance, parallel reduction, another grid or MPFR build, center-slow coordinates, or D3Q27. Q007y's coarse triangle-bound noncertificate remains a valid result for that deliberately coarser estimator.
